t: Pandas Rack 'Em: From Long to Wide with Automated Excel Formatting
s: This article details transforming 'long' format Pandas DataFrames into 'wide,' spreadsheet-friendly formats using `pivot_table` or `unstack`. It emphasizes automating column reordering and applying professional Excel formatting for actionable data deliverables.
sub: Professional Excel formatting automation (banded rows, text wrap, column widths)
